summary: Vitest 4.1.12 with jsdom 27.4.0 runs in src/fe; @firebase/app 0.16.5, @firebase/auth 1.13.9 and the testing libraries are installed at exact versions; root test chains the fe suite; src/fe/.env.example added.
produces: src/fe/vitest.config.ts (jsdom, test/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, no JSX config change was needed yet)
for_T2: Tests go in src/fe/test/; run one with npm --workspace easel-fe run test -- test/<file>. No Vitest config change was needed (runner test uses no JSX; .tsx not yet exercised).
for_T3: @firebase/app 0.16.5 and @firebase/auth 1.13.9 installed (modular API). Same test command.
next: npm 11.6.0 on Node v24.10.0. Needs an operator decision before merge: @firebase/app and @firebase/auth declare engines node >=24.12.0 (EBADENGINE warning here on 24.10.0, and CI runs Node 20.19.5; engine-strict is not set so install works, but runtime support on Node 20 is untested). Also the root-test string change breaks tests/process-security/ci-workflow.test.ts (see deviations).
deviations: tests/process-security/ci-workflow.test.ts line 46 asserts root scripts.test equals exactly 'node --import tsx scripts/discover-tests.mjs'. The Contract's new root test script makes that test fail, so root npm test exits non-zero (486/487 backend pass). I did not edit it (outside my write scope: src/** and handovers). Fix needed: update that assertion to the new string 'node --import tsx scripts/discover-tests.mjs && npm --workspace easel-fe run test'. Consequently the E82 root npm test pass was not demonstrated end to end; the fe suite alone passes.
src/fe/vitest.config.ts prints a Vite warning about ESM syntax in a CJS-loaded config (configLoader native); harmless, could be silenced with an .mts name or type module.
